plugin.name: Tony Hawk Pro Skater 2 Fusion Fix
FPSLimit.description: Limits the frame rate. Higher rates may affect gameplay. 0 is unlimited; -1 uses the monitor refresh rate.
MAIN.ResX.description: Width of the game picture in pixels. 0 uses the desktop resolution. Any size works, also sizes the monitor does not list. Takes effect after a restart.
MAIN.ResY.description: Height of the game picture in pixels. 0 uses the desktop resolution. Any size works, also sizes the monitor does not list. Takes effect after a restart.
MAIN.TextLanguage.description: Language of the fix's texts. Automatic uses English. Reopen Plugins to see the change.
menu.title: Advanced Options
menu.settingsfilehelp: Shows the settings file in File Explorer
SkipIntro.description: Skips the publisher and studio logos and the opening skating movie at start. Every movie can still be watched in Options, Movies. Takes effect after a restart.
MAIN.FOVFactor.description: Widens or narrows the skating camera. 1.0 keeps the game's framing on top of the widescreen view. Replays, demos and fixed camera angles keep their framing. Applies at once.
MAIN.WindowMode.description: Fullscreen, a window with a frame, or a borderless window covering the screen at the desktop resolution. Takes effect after a restart.
MAIN.HudAspectRatioConstraint.descriptio: Auto puts the score, special meter and stance icon at the screen edges and the goal list at the right edge. A ratio such as 16:9 keeps them inside a centred area of that shape. Timer, trick names and balance meter stay centred. In HORSE the shared score stays centred.
MAIN_ConfineCursor.description: Keeps the mouse pointer inside the active game window. It is released while the game is in the background, and at once when this is turned off.
menu.restoredefaultshelp: Restore this plugin's settings to their shipped defaults. Press again to confirm.
menu.presethelp: Choose a preset, then press twice to apply it to this plugin.
checkupdates.description: Checks once at start whether a newer version of the fix exists. A notice appears in Plugins, and FusionFixHub opens after the game exits if it is installed. Off makes no network request.
update.availablehub: An update for Tony Hawk Pro Skater 2 Fusion Fix is available. FusionFixHub will open after you exit the game.
update.availablesite: An update for Tony Hawk Pro Skater 2 Fusion Fix is available at fusionfix.io.
